SavedReconciliation.title: Saved Reconciliation
SavedReconciliation.description: A locked or saved reconciliation session (daily or monthly) for historical inspection

id.description: Unique identifier of the saved record

name.description: A human-friendly label for this saved record

type.description: Whether this is a daily or monthly reconciliation

date.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) or month (YYYY-MM) of this reconciliation

timestamp.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of when this record was saved

grandTotals.description: The aggregated totals for quick inspection

items.description: List of reconciled stock items matching the required columns layout

SavedAccuracy.title: Saved Accuracy
SavedAccuracy.description: A saved historical record of daily stock accuracy across all areas

id.description: Unique identifier of the saved accuracy record

name.description: A custom label/name for the saved accuracy session

date.description: The date or period of this accuracy check

totalSku.description: Total SKU count across all areas

totalSelisih.description: Total discrepant SKU count across all areas

allStockItems.description: Full list of compiled stock items for category filtering

StockActivityLog.title: Stock Activity Log
StockActivityLog.description: Real-time activity logs recording user modifications to stock for transparent SKU discrepancy tracking

id.description: Unique ID of the log entry

timestamp.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of the activity

username.description: Name or username of the user who performed the action

area.description: The warehouse branch area where the change occurred

actionType.description: Type of mutation or activity performed

impactSummary.description: Transparent explanation of the effect on stock discrepancies

WhatsAppLog.title: WhatsApp Log
WhatsAppLog.description: Logs of WhatsApp queries and bot responses

ActiveUser.title: Active User Session
ActiveUser.description: Heartbeat record of currently active users across branches

ProductOverride.title: Master Product Override
ProductOverride.description: Custom SKU properties and area RPH values

saved_reconciliations/{reconciliationId}.description: Collection storing historical locked stock reconciliation records

saved_accuracy/{accuracyId}.description: Collection storing historical daily/monthly stock accuracy metrics records

stock_activity_logs/{logId}.description: Collection storing stock change activity logs for SKU discrepancy auditing

whatsapp_logs/{waLogId}.description: Collection storing WhatsApp incoming and outgoing messages

activeUsers/{sessionId}.description: Collection storing active user presence heartbeats

master_produk_overrides/{pCode}.description: Collection storing master product metadata overrides
